gen-gf-paprika-gf-mada: Paprika's lowercase swells to fill the line like capitals. Mada follows in a plain sans with a towering midzone and curves that stay open, doing the quiet, approachable work the heading never attempts.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans reads modern and unfussy, its curves wide open. Paprika above it is the loud one, commanding and expressive, and the plain sans underneath lets that voice breathe without competing.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-matangi: Matangi reads as a hefty, contemporary sans, its strokes like twine pressed flat and its rounded letters left open. Shrink Paprika and it loses its swagger.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-maven-pro: Paprika's lowercase forms swell to fill the line like capitals, expressive and loud, with counters cut open like a hollow reed. Maven Pro stays quiet beside it.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-michroma: Paprika scatters its letters at a distance and still commands the line. Michroma, a plain sans with generous space around each letter and stubby ascender tips, supplies the contemporary, professional counterweight.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre draws each glyph with one tip, wire-thin and approachable, with a lowercase of cast iron stature. Paprika overhead is far louder and more expressive.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One reads big and friendly, its lowercase eye very large and its letters hung like clothespins. Paprika is the commanding voice, so the sans gets more room if you make it larger.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Paprika is commanding and expressive, its lowercase filling the line like capitals. Mochiy Pop P One is a plain sans with a sizable lowercase and wide gaps, bent-paperclip simple, and it would feel lost if the heading were made small.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-montserrat-underline: Commanding is how Paprika lands, its letters scattered at a distance and its lowercase huge. Montserrat Underline is a sans-serif with round bowls and an oversized lowercase, so a long passage reads like tracing one thick thread.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-mozilla-headline: Expressive is the right word for Paprika, whose lowercase fills the line like capitals while its counters breathe wide open. Mozilla Headline, a plain sans with big-bodied letters, handles the approachable part.
